diagnostic.message: conflicting show decorations for color job

source.text:
net decorations

(queued) -job-> [start] -job-> (running)
@done_in: (running) -job-> [finish]
[finish] -receipt-> (done)
@done_in predicate cel "job.exitCode == 0"

decorate color job show "id"
decorate color job show "owner.name"
